name: Growth
tagline: Prepare experiment variants and collect results from your connected analytics tools.

useCases.title: Experiment design
useCases.description: Turn a hypothesis into a structured test: variants, success metric, sample size, and a stop rule, ready to launch.

useCases.title: Variant generation
useCases.description: Generate landing-page copy, ad angles, and subject lines in bulk, based on your top performers.

useCases.title: Funnel analysis
useCases.description: Pull conversion data across the funnel, find the biggest drop-off, and propose the next experiment to run there.

useCases.title: Automated readouts
useCases.description: On a schedule, gather a running test's results and write a readout with significance and a recommendation.

useCases.title: Lifecycle and onboarding emails
useCases.description: Draft and test an onboarding or re-engagement sequence, then queue it into your email platform.

useCases.title: Cohort and retention analysis
useCases.description: Slice users into cohorts, compare retention curves, and summarize what separates the ones that stick.

faq.q: Can an experiment run on its own?
faq.a: Yes. Build it as a scheduled workflow that generates variants, launches them through connected tools, collects results, and drafts the readout. You decide what to scale.

faq.q: Won't generating this many variants get expensive?
faq.a: Not if you route it. Send bulk generation to a cheap or local model and the high-stakes piece to a stronger one, with Gateway budgets per workflow.

faq.q: Can it act on our analytics and ad tools directly?
faq.a: Yes. Through Connections, agents sign in to your analytics, ad platforms, and email tools to pull metrics and push changes. You can keep a sign-off step before anything goes live.
